design_notes.e_direction: per-point TOP eigenvector of M_zhat (stiff/counter-image direction); g_M = e^T M e = lambda1 (as T12).
design_notes.H_zhat: diag(std_z) (-hessian(prob_model.log_prob(z)[0])) diag(std_z); INCLUDES prior + logdet (prior smooth at tooth scale).
design_notes.g_R: g_M - g_H = everything-not-GN quadratic form = residual term (sum W_i r_i grad^2 m_i) + prior Hessian, along e.
design_notes.detrend: LINEAR moving median (1-px window of MEASURED displacement), reusing T12 detrend_log; amplitudes are d_max-d_min over the central +/-1.5 px (linear, native units / nats). Linear because the cancellation g_M = g_H + g_R is ADDITIVE.
design_notes.std_z: ONE common standardization from the ORIGINAL run's pooled samples (so OLD/NEW curvatures are directly comparable).
design_notes.z_path: SHARED: calibrated ONCE on the OLD model (render is data-independent) and both targets evaluated at the SAME 97 Z.

gates.note: the two gates reconcile against DIFFERENT observed/err maps (OLD ss2 data vs NEW d'); both must pass -- that is expected.

W_difference.note: W = 1/err^2; err map derives from each target's OWN observed image, so W differs slightly. M and hence g_M differ by ~this over the counter-image window.

falsifier_gH_over_gM.falsifier: >= 0.333 (g_H >= g_M/3) while arm samples fast => wash-out wrong

cross_target.note: M = J^T W J is data-independent up to the small W (err-map) shift; g_M should be ~identical between targets.

verdict: proposed (UNCERTIFIED) -- no adjudication (a grader inspects the plots/JSON, not this script).
